bio: Combining modern features with the original wood and stone, plus cordial service and a pleasingly down-to-earth atmosphere, this charming 15C Grisons building provides a wonderful setting in which to enjoy seasonal ingredient-led cuisine. The focus is on the essentials, so the flavoursome dishes are served in pared-down combinations. Tip: Make the most of the quiet terrace in summer! There is a small and simple lunch deal....
